title: Affine nonvanishing loci from a finite affine section cover
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a universally closed morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with S affine. Let L be an invertible O_X-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Suppose a finite family of global sections x_j of L has affine nonvanishing opens $D_j=X$ minus the support of its zero scheme [lem-pc-zero-scheme-properties], and these opens cover X. Then the nonvanishing open of every global section s of L is affine. No regularity of s, reducedness, Noetherianity, or nonemptiness is assumed.

source.place: isAffineOpen_compl_support_zeroLocus, including its module docstring; the affine reciprocal-cover valuative criterion. Compare Stacks morphisms.tex Tag 0EKE for the proper ample application.

proof.text: On D_j the section x_j is a free generator. Write s=a_j x_j and let U=X_s. The coefficient zero-locus calculation gives U∩D_j=D(a_j). On U, s is a free generator, so write x_j=g_j s. The same calculation on affine subopens of U shows D(g_j)⊆D_j. Restrict the two equations to U∩D_j and cancel the free generator s: a_j g_j=1. Apply the proved IsAffineOpen.of_universallyClosed reciprocal-cover criterion to f, the finite affine cover D_j, U, a_j and g_j. This gives U affine, also when U or the index set is empty. These are exactly the steps of the attached, already proved source-library theorem.

theorem isAffineOpen_compl_support_zeroLocus {S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f]
    [IsAffine S] (L : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible.{u, u, u} L] {ι : Type*}
    [Finite ι] (x : ι → (𝟙_ X.Modules ⟶ L))

    (hcov : ⨆ j, (Hom.zeroLocus (x j)).support.compl = ⊤) (s : 𝟙_ X.Modules ⟶ L) :
    IsAffineOpen (Hom.zeroLocus s).support.compl
